lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、この本を三冊借りたいです。
lines.en: Excuse me, I'd like to borrow these three books.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。あ、カードの期限が先週で終わっていますね。
lines.en: Sure. Oh, your card expired last week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: え、そうですか。今、新しくできますか。
lines.en: Oh, really? Can I renew it now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。でも、住所がわかるものが必要です。学生証はありますか。
lines.en: Yes. But you need something that shows your address. Do you have your student ID?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 学生証は家に忘れました。免許証なら持っています。
lines.en: I left my student ID at home. I have my driving licence, though.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 免許証の住所は、今の住所と同じですか。
lines.en: Is the address on your licence the same as your current address?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: いいえ、先月引っ越したので、前の住所です。
lines.en: No, I moved last month, so it's my old address.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうですか。それでは、今日は更新できません。でも、今日は二冊まで借りられますよ。
lines.en: I see. Then we can't renew it today. But you can borrow up to two books today.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: じゃあ、この二冊だけ借ります。明日、学生証を持ってきます。
lines.en: Then I'll just borrow these two. I'll bring my student ID tomorrow.

questions.question: Why can't Yamada renew his card today?
choices: He left his library card at home
His driving licence has expired
His ID doesn't show where he lives now
He is trying to borrow three books

questions.question: What will Yamada do today?
choices: Borrow all three books using his licence
Borrow two books and come back tomorrow
Go home now and fetch his student ID
Leave without borrowing anything

dialogues.title: A seat on the night bus

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、金曜日の夜のバスを一枚お願いします。
lines.en: Excuse me, one ticket for Friday night's bus, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 大阪行きですね。窓側と通路側、どちらがいいですか。
lines.en: To Osaka, right? Would you like a window seat or an aisle seat?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 窓側がいいです。外を見たいので。
lines.en: A window seat, please. I want to look outside.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: すみません、窓側はもう後ろの席しかありません。トイレの近くですが、いいですか。
lines.en: I'm sorry, the only window seats left are at the back. It's near the toilet — is that all right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うーん、トイレの近くはちょっと……。夜は静かなところで寝たいです。
lines.en: Hmm, near the toilet is a bit… At night I want to sleep somewhere quiet.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: では、女性専用の席はどうですか。前のほうにあって、三番目の通路側が空いています。
lines.en: Then how about the women-only seats? They're near the front, and the third-row aisle seat is free.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 女性専用の席は高いですか。
lines.en: Are the women-only seats more expensive?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: いいえ、同じ値段です。
lines.en: No, they're the same price.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: じゃあ、それにします。夜は暗いから、どうせ外は見えませんよね。
lines.en: Then I'll take that. It's dark at night, so I wouldn't see anything outside anyway.

questions.question: Why doesn't Hayashi take a window seat?
choices: Window seats cost more than aisle seats
The only window seats left are by the toilet
Window seats are for women only
All the window seats were already sold

questions.question: Which seat does she end up with?
choices: A window seat at the back
An aisle seat near the toilet
A window seat in the third row
A women-only aisle seat near the front

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 森さん、来週の月曜日のテストのことですが、日にちが変わりました。
lines.en: Mori, about next Monday's test — the date has changed.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: え、いつになりましたか。
lines.en: Oh, when is it now?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 最初は金曜日にしたかったんですが、金曜日は教室が使えないんです。
lines.en: At first I wanted Friday, but we can't use the classroom on Friday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうですか。じゃあ、次の週ですか。
lines.en: I see. So is it the week after?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: いいえ、水曜日の三時間目です。
lines.en: No, it's Wednesday, third period.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 水曜日は病院の予約があって、午後は休むんです。
lines.en: On Wednesday I have a hospital appointment, so I'm off in the afternoon.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 三時間目は午前ですよ。十時半から始まります。
lines.en: Third period is in the morning. It starts at ten thirty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、それなら大丈夫です。予約は二時ですから。
lines.en: Oh, then it's fine. My appointment is at two.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: よかった。範囲は変わりません。教科書の五課までです。
lines.en: Good. The scope hasn't changed — up to chapter five of the textbook.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: わかりました。クラスの友達にも伝えておきます。
lines.en: Got it. I'll tell my classmates too.

questions.question: When will the test be held?
choices: Next Monday
Friday morning
Wednesday morning
Wednesday afternoon

questions.question: Why wasn't the test moved to Friday?
choices: The classroom isn't available that day
Mori has a hospital appointment
The teacher will be away
The scope of the test changed

questions.question: What will Mori do next?
choices: Change her hospital appointment
Ask to take the test on Friday
Study only up to chapter four
Pass the news on to her classmates

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、昨日ここで買った靴なんですが、少し小さかったんです。
lines.en: Excuse me, these are shoes I bought here yesterday, but they were a little small.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうですか。レシートはお持ちですか。
lines.en: I see. Do you have the receipt?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: はい、これです。一つ大きいサイズに替えてもらえますか。
lines.en: Yes, here it is. Could you change them for one size bigger?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 申し訳ありません。この色は、大きいサイズがもうないんです。
lines.en: I'm very sorry. In this colour we don't have the bigger size any more.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうですか……。じゃあ、お金を返してもらえますか。
lines.en: I see… Then could I get my money back?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい、できます。でも、同じ靴の黒なら、大きいサイズがありますよ。
lines.en: Yes, we can do that. But we do have the same shoe in black in the bigger size.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 黒ですか。白がよかったんですが……。ちょっとはいてみてもいいですか。
lines.en: Black? I wanted white… Could I try them on?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: どうぞ。
lines.en: Go ahead.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、ちょうどいいです。黒も思ったより悪くないですね。これにします。
lines.en: Oh, they fit perfectly. Black isn't as bad as I thought. I'll take these.

questions.question: Why can't Ishii get the exchange she first asked for?
choices: She doesn't have the receipt with her
The shop has no bigger size in her colour
Shoes can't be exchanged the next day
The shop can only give her money back

questions.question: What does Ishii finally do?
choices: Gets a refund for the shoes
Keeps the small white pair
Takes a bigger pair in white
Swaps them for a bigger black pair

speakers.name: 小林
speakers.hint: tenant, polite, a little cold and tired

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: もしもし、203号室の小林です。部屋のヒーターが壊れてしまったんです。
lines.en: Hello, this is Kobayashi in room 203. The heater in my room has broken.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: それは困りましたね。いつからですか。
lines.en: Oh dear. Since when?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 昨日の夜からです。スイッチを入れても、温かくならないんです。
lines.en: Since last night. Even when I switch it on, it doesn't get warm.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: わかりました。今日の午後、修理の人に行ってもらいましょう。
lines.en: All right. I'll have a repair person come this afternoon.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、今日は午後からアルバイトで、七時まで帰れないんです。
lines.en: Sorry, I have my part-time job from this afternoon and won't be back until seven.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: じゃあ、明日の朝はどうですか。
lines.en: Then how about tomorrow morning?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 明日の朝は早く出かけます。あの、合鍵で入ってもらってもいいですよ。
lines.en: I leave early tomorrow morning. Um, you can let them in with the spare key.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: いや、留守の部屋に入るのはちょっと……。土曜日はどうですか。
lines.en: No, going into a room when nobody's home is not really… How about Saturday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 土曜日なら一日中います。でも、それまで寒いですね。
lines.en: I'm home all day on Saturday. But it'll be cold until then.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うちに古いストーブがあるから、今晩持っていきますよ。
lines.en: I have an old stove at my place, so I'll bring it over tonight.

questions.question: When will the heater be repaired?
choices: This afternoon
Tomorrow morning
On Saturday
Tonight after seven

questions.question: Why doesn't the landlord use the spare key?
choices: He doesn't want to enter while she is out
The repair person can't come in the morning
She will be home all day on Saturday
He can't find the spare key

questions.question: What will the landlord do tonight?
choices: Lend her the spare key
Bring her an old heater to use
Call the repair person again
Come and look at the heater himself

dialogues.title: What to cook for the party

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 土曜日のパーティー、何を作ろうかな。カレーはどう？
lines.en: What should I make for Saturday's party? How about curry?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: カレーはいいけど、先月のパーティーもカレーだったよね。
lines.en: Curry's nice, but we had curry at last month's party too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうか。じゃあ、天ぷらは？
lines.en: True. Then what about tempura?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 天ぷらは油をたくさん使うから、パーティーの前が大変だよ。
lines.en: Tempura uses a lot of oil, so it'd be a lot of work before the party.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: うーん。じゃあ、鍋にしようか。みんなで作りながら食べられるし。
lines.en: Hmm. Then shall we do hotpot? Everyone can cook and eat together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: いいね。あ、でも、さくらさんは肉が食べられないって。
lines.en: Nice. Oh, but Sakura said she can't eat meat.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そっか。じゃあ、魚と野菜の鍋にすればいいね。
lines.en: Right. Then we can make a fish and vegetable hotpot.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うん、それなら大丈夫。私、デザートにケーキを買っていくね。
lines.en: Yeah, that works. I'll buy a cake for dessert.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: ありがとう。じゃあ、ぼくは明日、材料を買いに行くよ。
lines.en: Thanks. Then I'll go and buy the ingredients tomorrow.

questions.question: What will they serve as the main dish?
choices: Curry, like last month
Tempura
A meat hotpot
A hotpot without meat

questions.question: Why don't they make tempura?
choices: They had it at the last party
It would take too much work beforehand
Sakura can't eat it
Yumi is bringing a cake instead

questions.question: What will Yumi do?
choices: Buy the hotpot ingredients
Ask Sakura what she can eat
Bring something sweet
Cook the fish

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、このDVDを返したいんですが、昨日が返す日でした。
lines.en: Excuse me, I'd like to return this DVD, but it was due yesterday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。一日遅れですので、延滞料金が百円かかります。
lines.en: All right. It's one day late, so there's a 100-yen late fee.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 百円ですね。あ、それから、この続きも借りたいんですが。
lines.en: 100 yen, OK. Oh, and I'd also like to borrow the next one.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 続きの二巻ですね。今、ほかの方が借りていて、戻るのは日曜日です。
lines.en: Volume two? Someone else has it right now; it comes back on Sunday.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうですか。じゃあ、予約できますか。
lines.en: I see. Can I reserve it, then?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。でも、会員カードが今月までなので、先に更新が必要です。
lines.en: Yes. But your membership card is only valid until this month, so you need to renew it first.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 更新はいくらですか。
lines.en: How much is renewal?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 三百円です。今日更新すると、延滞料金はいりません。
lines.en: 300 yen. If you renew today, you don't have to pay the late fee.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: え、本当ですか。じゃあ、更新して、二巻を予約します。
lines.en: Really? Then I'll renew and reserve volume two.

questions.question: How much does Nakamura pay in total today?
choices: 100 yen
300 yen
400 yen
Nothing

questions.question: Why can't he take volume two home today?
choices: His membership card has already expired
He returned volume one late
Another customer has it until Sunday
The shop doesn't stock volume two

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 田村さん、こんにちは。最近、茶色の猫がうちの庭によく来るんです。
lines.en: Hello, Mrs Tamura. Lately a brown cat keeps coming into my garden.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: あら、それはうちのミミかもしれません。首に赤いリボンがありましたか。
lines.en: Oh, that might be our Mimi. Did it have a red ribbon around its neck?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: はい、ありました。かわいいんですが、花を植えたところを掘るんです。
lines.en: Yes, it did. It's cute, but it digs where I've planted flowers.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: まあ、ごめんなさい。家の中に入れておきましょうか。
lines.en: Oh dear, I'm sorry. Shall I keep her inside the house?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: いえ、そこまでしなくても大丈夫です。
lines.en: No, you don't have to go that far.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: でも、困るでしょう。
lines.en: But it's a nuisance for you, isn't it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 実は、猫は嫌いじゃないんです。ただ、花のところに入らないようにしたいんです。
lines.en: Actually, I don't dislike cats. I just want to keep it out of the flower bed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: じゃあ、猫が嫌いなにおいのものを、花の周りに置いたらどうかしら。うちにありますよ。
lines.en: Then how about putting something with a smell cats hate around the flowers? I have some at home.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: それはいいですね。お願いします。
lines.en: That's a good idea. Yes, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 今から持っていきますね。
lines.en: I'll bring it over right now.

questions.question: What is Aoki's problem?
choices: The cat digs up his flower bed
The cat comes inside his house
He is afraid of cats
The cat has lost its red ribbon

questions.question: Why does Aoki say Mimi doesn't need to be kept indoors?
choices: He thinks the cat belongs to someone else
He plans to move his flowers elsewhere
He has no problem with the cat itself
He already has something to keep cats away

questions.question: What will Mrs Tamura do next?
choices: Keep Mimi inside from now on
Take off Mimi's ribbon
Plant new flowers for him
Bring over something cats dislike

speakers.name: 職員
speakers.hint: courteous city-hall clerk, clear and patient

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、先週この市に引っ越してきたので、転入届を出したいんですが。
lines.en: Excuse me, I moved to this city last week, so I'd like to file a moving-in notice.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。前の市役所でもらった転出証明書はお持ちですか。
lines.en: Certainly. Do you have the moving-out certificate from your previous city office?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: え、それが必要なんですか。持ってきていません。
lines.en: Oh, is that required? I didn't bring it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい、それがないと、こちらでは手続きができないんです。
lines.en: Yes, without it we can't process the registration here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 困ったな。前の市は遠くて、平日は仕事で行けないんです。
lines.en: That's a problem. My old city is far, and I can't go on weekdays because of work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: それでしたら、マイナンバーカードはお持ちですか。カードがあれば、転出の届けはオンラインで出せますよ。
lines.en: In that case, do you have your My Number card? With the card, you can file the moving-out notice online.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: カードならあります。じゃあ、今日オンラインでやればいいんですね。
lines.en: I do have the card. So I just need to do it online today.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。ただ、申請してから、こちらで受け付けられるまで二、三日かかります。
lines.en: Yes. However, it takes two or three days after you apply before we can accept it here.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうですか。では、来週の土曜日に来てもいいですか。
lines.en: I see. Then can I come next Saturday?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 申し訳ありません。土曜日は窓口が閉まっていて、毎月第二日曜日の午前中だけ開いています。
lines.en: I'm sorry. The counter is closed on Saturdays; it's only open on the morning of the second Sunday of each month.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: じゃあ、その日曜日に来ます。カードを忘れないようにします。
lines.en: Then I'll come that Sunday. I'll make sure not to forget my card.

questions.question: Why can't Watanabe complete his registration today?
choices: He is missing a document from his previous city
He forgot to bring his My Number card
His online application hasn't been accepted
The counter is closed on weekdays

questions.question: What is the first thing Watanabe will do?
choices: Visit his old city office on a weekday
Come back to this office on Saturday
File the moving-out notice online
Come back on a Sunday morning

questions.question: Why doesn't he come back next Saturday?
choices: His application won't be ready by then
The office counter doesn't open on Saturdays
He has to work that day
He needs to go to his old city first

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 岡本さん、ちょっとお願いがあるんですけど、来週の金曜日のシフト、代わってもらえませんか。
lines.en: Okamoto, I have a favour to ask. Could you take my shift next Friday?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 金曜日って、夕方五時からのシフトですよね。何かあったんですか。
lines.en: Friday — that's the shift from 5 p.m., right? Did something come up?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 実は、姉の結婚式の準備を手伝うことになって。
lines.en: Actually, I've ended up helping with preparations for my sister's wedding.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうなんですか。代わってあげたいんですけど、金曜日の夜は授業があるんです。
lines.en: Oh, I see. I'd like to cover for you, but I have a class on Friday evenings.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうですか……。じゃあ、仕方ないですね。
lines.en: I see… Well, it can't be helped.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、でも、授業は八時に終わるから、八時からなら入れますよ。
lines.en: Oh, but my class ends at eight, so I could work from eight.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 本当ですか。準備は九時ごろまでかかりそうなので、それだと助かります。
lines.en: Really? The preparations will probably go until about nine, so that would help a lot.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 五時から八時は、店長に聞いてみたらどうですか。最近人が足りないって言ってたから、自分で入るかもしれません。
lines.en: Why not ask the manager about five to eight? He said lately we're short of people, so he might cover it himself.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうですね。店長には私から話してみます。
lines.en: Good idea. I'll talk to the manager myself.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: その代わり、再来週の日曜日の朝、ぼくの代わりに入ってもらえますか。
lines.en: In return, could you take my Sunday morning shift the week after next?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: もちろんです。本当にありがとうございます。
lines.en: Of course. Thank you so much.

questions.question: How much of Friday's shift will Okamoto work?
choices: The whole shift from five
Only the part after his class
Only until his class starts
None of it, because of his class

questions.question: What does Okamoto ask for in return?
choices: That she cover one of his Sunday mornings
That she speak to the manager for him
That she work next Friday night
That she come to his class with him

questions.question: Who will talk to the manager?
choices: Okamoto, after his class
Matsuda's sister
Nobody; the manager already agreed
Matsuda herself

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい、あおば皮膚科です。
lines.en: Hello, Aoba Dermatology.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: もしもし、高橋と申します。明日の十時に予約しているんですが、変更をお願いしたいんです。
lines.en: Hello, my name is Takahashi. I have an appointment tomorrow at ten, but I'd like to change it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 高橋様ですね。ご希望の日時はございますか。
lines.en: Mr Takahashi. Do you have a preferred date and time?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 木曜日の夕方は空いていますか。仕事の後に行きたいんですが。
lines.en: Is Thursday evening free? I'd like to come after work.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 木曜日は、先生が午前中しかいらっしゃらないんです。夕方でしたら、金曜日の六時が空いております。
lines.en: On Thursdays the doctor is only here in the morning. If you want the evening, Friday at six is available.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 金曜日の六時ですね。それでお願いします。
lines.en: Friday at six. That's fine, please.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: かしこまりました。ただ、前回お出しした薬は、明日でなくなりますよね。
lines.en: Certainly. However, the medicine we gave you last time runs out tomorrow, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、そうです。金曜日までは足りないですね。
lines.en: Oh, that's right. It won't last until Friday.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: お薬だけでしたら、明日、受付でお出しできます。診察なしで大丈夫です。
lines.en: If it's just the medicine, we can give it to you at reception tomorrow. You won't need to see the doctor.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: じゃあ、明日の昼休みに、薬だけ取りに行きます。
lines.en: Then I'll come by during my lunch break tomorrow just for the medicine.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。保険証を忘れずにお持ちください。
lines.en: Very well. Please don't forget your insurance card.

questions.question: When will Takahashi see the doctor?
choices: Tomorrow at ten
Thursday evening
Friday at six
Tomorrow at lunchtime

questions.question: Why won't Thursday evening work?
choices: The clinic is closed all day Thursday
The doctor is only there that morning
Takahashi has to work late that day
Thursday evening is already fully booked

questions.question: Why will Takahashi go to the clinic tomorrow anyway?
choices: The doctor wants to examine him once more
He has to hand in his insurance card
He still has his ten o'clock appointment
He needs more medicine before Friday

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: お客様、大変申し訳ございません。札幌行きの最終便は、雪のため欠航となりました。
lines.en: Sir, we're terribly sorry. The last flight to Sapporo has been cancelled because of snow.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: えっ、欠航ですか。明日の朝、札幌で大事な会議があるんですが。
lines.en: What, cancelled? I have an important meeting in Sapporo tomorrow morning.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 明日の始発便は七時発で、札幌には八時半に到着いたします。
lines.en: Tomorrow's first flight leaves at seven and arrives in Sapporo at eight thirty.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 会議は九時からなんです。空港から会場まで一時間かかるので、間に合いませんね。
lines.en: The meeting starts at nine. It takes an hour from the airport to the venue, so I won't make it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: ほかの航空会社の今夜九時の便でしたら、キャンセル待ちができますが、お席が取れるかどうかはわかりません。
lines.en: You could wait for a cancellation on another airline's nine o'clock flight tonight, but we can't say whether you'd get a seat.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うーん、待って乗れなかったら、今夜のホテルも取れないかもしれませんね。
lines.en: Hmm, if I wait and don't get on, I might not even be able to find a hotel for tonight.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。始発便でしたら、今、確実にお席をお取りできます。
lines.en: Yes. On the first flight, we can definitely reserve you a seat right now.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: わかりました。始発便にします。会議の最初の三十分は、空港からオンラインで参加させてもらいます。
lines.en: All right. I'll take the first flight. I'll join the first thirty minutes of the meeting online from the airport.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: かしこまりました。今夜のホテルは、こちらで空港の近くにご用意いたします。
lines.en: Certainly. We'll arrange a hotel near the airport for you tonight.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 助かります。ありがとうございます。
lines.en: That's a big help. Thank you.

questions.question: What does Nishimura decide to do?
choices: Wait for a seat on another airline tonight
Fly out first thing tomorrow morning
Find a hotel in Sapporo for tonight
Skip the meeting in Sapporo

questions.question: Why does he turn down the other airline's flight?
choices: That flight was cancelled due to snow too
It lands after his meeting has started
He might not get on and be left stranded
It is fully booked with no waiting list

questions.question: How will he handle the start of the meeting?
choices: He will join it online before arriving
He will ask for it to begin at ten
He will miss the first hour completely
He will attend from his hotel room

speakers.name: スタッフ
speakers.hint: upbeat gym staff, salesy but friendly

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、入会したいんですが、どんなプランがありますか。
lines.en: Excuse me, I'd like to join. What plans do you have?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。いつでも使えるフルタイム会員が月八千円、平日の昼だけのデイタイム会員が月五千円です。
lines.en: Sure. Full-time membership, usable any time, is 8,000 yen a month; daytime membership, weekday days only, is 5,000 yen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 昼は仕事なので、夜に来たいんです。
lines.en: I work during the day, so I want to come in the evenings.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: それでしたら、平日の夜七時以降と週末が使えるナイト会員が六千円です。
lines.en: In that case, night membership — weekdays after 7 p.m. plus weekends — is 6,000 yen.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 週末は子どもの習い事があるので、あまり来られないと思います。
lines.en: On weekends my child has lessons, so I don't think I can come much.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: では、回数券はいかがですか。十回で七千円で、三か月使えます。
lines.en: Then how about a multi-visit ticket? Ten visits for 7,000 yen, valid for three months.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: うーん、週に二回は来たいので、三か月で十回だと足りないですね。
lines.en: Hmm, I want to come at least twice a week, so ten visits in three months isn't enough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうですね。週二回なら、ナイト会員のほうがお得です。今月入会すると、入会金もかかりません。
lines.en: True. At twice a week, the night membership is better value. And if you join this month, there's no joining fee.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: じゃあ、ナイト会員にします。週末は使えなくてもいいです。
lines.en: Then I'll go with the night membership. It's fine if I can't use the weekends.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: ありがとうございます。では、こちらの用紙にご記入ください。
lines.en: Thank you. Then please fill in this form.

questions.question: Which plan does Sasaki choose?
choices: The plan usable at any time
The weekday daytime plan
Weekday evenings plus weekends
Ten visits over three months

questions.question: Why doesn't she buy the multi-visit ticket?
choices: It can't be used in the evenings
It costs more than the full-time plan
She can't come on weekends anyway
It wouldn't cover how often she wants to come

speakers.name: 吉田
speakers.hint: parent, anxious at first, then relaxed

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: もしもし、吉田さんのお宅ですか。翔太君の担任の木下です。
lines.en: Hello, is this the Yoshida residence? This is Kinoshita, Shota's homeroom teacher.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: あ、先生、いつもお世話になっております。翔太が何か……。
lines.en: Oh, hello, thank you for all you do. Has Shota done something…?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: いえ、心配なことではないんです。来月の面談の日程のことでお電話しました。
lines.en: No, nothing to worry about. I'm calling about the schedule for next month's meeting.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: はい、確か十日の四時でしたよね。
lines.en: Yes, it was the tenth at four, I believe.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: それが、その日に学校の行事が入ってしまいまして、十二日か十三日に変えていただけないでしょうか。
lines.en: About that — a school event has come up that day, so could we change it to the twelfth or thirteenth?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 十二日は夫も私も仕事で……。十三日は何時ですか。
lines.en: On the twelfth my husband and I both work… What times are there on the thirteenth?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 十三日は、三時からと五時からが空いています。
lines.en: On the thirteenth, three o'clock and five o'clock are free.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 三時は難しいですが、五時なら大丈夫です。あの、主人も一緒に行ってもいいですか。
lines.en: Three would be hard, but five is fine. Um, may my husband come too?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: もちろんです。翔太君の進路のことも話したいので、ぜひご一緒に。
lines.en: Of course. I'd like to talk about Shota's plans after graduation too, so please do come together.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: わかりました。翔太にも伝えておきます。
lines.en: Understood. I'll let Shota know as well.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: それから、面談の前に、この前配った進路のアンケートを出してください。
lines.en: Also, before the meeting, please hand in the questionnaire about future plans I gave out the other day.

questions.question: Why did the teacher call?
choices: Shota got into trouble at school
The meeting has to be rescheduled
Shota forgot to hand something in
He wants the parents at a school event

questions.question: When will the meeting now take place?
choices: The tenth at four
The twelfth
The thirteenth at three
The thirteenth at five

questions.question: What does the teacher ask the family to do before the meeting?
choices: Return a form about Shota's future
Attend the school event on the tenth
Choose between three and five o'clock
Tell him whether the father is coming

speakers.name: 受付
speakers.hint: courier call-centre operator, formal and smooth

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: お電話ありがとうございます。ひまわり運輸、再配達の受付でございます。
lines.en: Thank you for calling Himawari Transport, redelivery desk.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、不在票が入っていたので、再配達をお願いしたいんですが。
lines.en: Hello, I found a missed-delivery notice, so I'd like to request redelivery.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: かしこまりました。伝票番号をお願いいたします。
lines.en: Certainly. May I have the tracking number?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 4815-2230です。今日の夜、届けてもらえますか。
lines.en: It's 4815-2230. Could you deliver it tonight?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 申し訳ございません。本日の夜の配達は、もう受付が終わってしまいました。明日の午前中はいかがでしょうか。
lines.en: I'm very sorry. Requests for tonight's delivery have already closed. How about tomorrow morning?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 明日は朝から出かけるんです。夜は何時ごろになりますか。
lines.en: I'm out from the morning tomorrow. What time would the evening delivery be?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 夜ですと、七時から九時の間になります。
lines.en: In the evening, it would be between seven and nine.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 明日は帰りが遅くなるかもしれないので……。近くのコンビニで受け取ることはできますか。
lines.en: I might be late getting home tomorrow… Can I pick it up at a nearby convenience store?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 通常はできますが、こちらのお荷物は冷蔵品ですので、コンビニではお預かりできないんです。
lines.en: Normally yes, but this package needs refrigeration, so convenience stores can't hold it.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうか、実家からの野菜でした。じゃあ、明後日の午前中にお願いします。明後日は休みなので。
lines.en: Oh right, it's vegetables from my parents. Then the morning of the day after tomorrow, please. I'm off that day.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 承知いたしました。明後日の午前中にお届けいたします。
lines.en: Understood. We'll deliver it the morning of the day after tomorrow.

questions.question: When will the package be delivered?
choices: This evening
Tomorrow morning
Tomorrow between seven and nine
In two days' time, in the morning

questions.question: Why can't Noguchi collect it from a convenience store?
choices: The contents have to be kept cold
She is going out early tomorrow
Tonight's deliveries are already closed
She doesn't have the tracking number

speakers.name: 部長
speakers.hint: manager, plain speech, encouraging but firm

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 井上さん、来週の会議で新商品の説明をしてもらいたいんだけど、どうかな。
lines.en: Inoue, I'd like you to explain the new product at next week's meeting. What do you think?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 私ですか。この企画を中心になって進めたのは、前田さんですが……。
lines.en: Me? But it was Maeda who led this project…

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 前田さんは来週、大阪に出張なんだよ。
lines.en: Maeda is on a business trip to Osaka next week.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうなんですか。でも、私、人前で話すのがあまり得意じゃなくて……。
lines.en: Oh, really? But I'm not very good at speaking in front of people…

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 資料は前田さんが作ってくれたし、井上さんはデータのところをいちばんよく知っているだろう？
lines.en: Maeda has already made the materials, and you know the data part better than anyone, right?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: はい、データは私が集めました。では、前田さんに内容を確認してから、準備します。
lines.en: Yes, I collected the data. Then I'll check the content with Maeda and prepare.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: それから、会議は木曜日の予定だったけど、社長の都合で水曜日になったから。
lines.en: Also, the meeting was planned for Thursday, but it's been moved to Wednesday to suit the president.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 水曜日ですか。前田さんは火曜日から出張ですよね。
lines.en: Wednesday? Maeda leaves on the trip on Tuesday, doesn't he?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そうだね。じゃあ、今週中に一度練習して、私と前田さんに聞かせてくれる？
lines.en: That's right. So could you do a practice run this week for me and Maeda?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: わかりました。金曜日の午後でよろしいでしょうか。
lines.en: Understood. Would Friday afternoon be all right?

questions.question: Why is Inoue asked to give the presentation?
choices: Maeda will be away on business
Inoue led the project from the start
The president asked for her by name
Maeda doesn't like speaking in public

questions.question: What will Inoue do this week?
choices: Travel to Osaka with Maeda
Make new materials on her own
Rehearse in front of her manager and Maeda
Ask for the meeting to stay on Thursday

speakers.name: 藤田
speakers.hint: older customer, careful with money, chatty

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、スマホの料金が高いので、安いプランに変えたいんですが。
lines.en: Excuse me, my smartphone bill is high, so I'd like to switch to a cheaper plan.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: かしこまりました。今、毎月どのくらいデータを使っていらっしゃいますか。
lines.en: Certainly. How much data do you use each month at the moment?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 家ではWi-Fiなので、外ではほとんど使いません。
lines.en: I use Wi-Fi at home, so I hardly use any when I'm out.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: でしたら、三ギガで月千五百円のプランがおすすめです。
lines.en: Then I'd recommend the 3-gigabyte plan at 1,500 yen a month.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 安いですね。でも、電話はよくかけるんです。孫とか、病院とか。
lines.en: That's cheap. But I make a lot of calls — to my grandchild, the hospital…

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: そのプランですと、通話は三十秒二十二円かかります。かけ放題を付けると、プラス千円です。
lines.en: On that plan, calls cost 22 yen per 30 seconds. Adding unlimited calling is 1,000 yen more.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 合わせて二千五百円ですか。今は七千円なので、それでもずいぶん安いですね。
lines.en: So 2,500 in total? I pay 7,000 now, so that's still much cheaper.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: はい。あるいは、五分以内の通話が無料になるオプションなら、プラス五百円です。
lines.en: Yes. Or there's an option that makes calls under five minutes free, for 500 yen more.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 孫とは長く話すから、五分じゃ足りないなあ。
lines.en: I talk with my grandchild for a long time, so five minutes isn't enough.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: では、かけ放題のほうが安心ですね。
lines.en: Then unlimited calling would give you peace of mind.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうしましょう。それでお願いします。
lines.en: Let's do that. That one, please.

questions.question: How much will Fujita pay per month on his new plan?
Why doesn't he choose the cheaper call option?
choices: It costs more than unlimited calling
His calls with his grandchild run long
He rarely makes phone calls
He uses a lot of data outside

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: すみません、さっき三階のトイレに傘を忘れてしまったんですが。
lines.en: Excuse me, I left my umbrella in the third-floor restroom a little while ago.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: どのような傘でしょうか。
lines.en: What kind of umbrella is it?

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 紺色の長い傘で、持つところが木でできています。
lines.en: A long navy umbrella with a wooden handle.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: 少々お待ちください。……今、届いているのは、紺色の折りたたみ傘だけですね。
lines.en: One moment, please… The only one handed in is a navy folding umbrella.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: 折りたたみじゃないんです。じゃあ、自分で見に行ってもいいですか。
lines.en: Mine isn't a folding one. Then may I go and look myself?

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: もちろんです。ただ、清掃の者がもう片付けているかもしれません。
lines.en: Of course. However, the cleaning staff may already have cleared it away.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: そうですか……。これから駅で友達と会うので、あまり時間がないんです。
lines.en: I see… I'm meeting a friend at the station now, so I don't have much time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: それでしたら、こちらの用紙にお名前とお電話番号を書いていただければ、見つかり次第ご連絡いたします。
lines.en: In that case, if you write your name and phone number on this form, we'll contact you as soon as it's found.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: お願いします。でも、雨が降っているので、帰りはどうしよう……。
lines.en: Please do. But it's raining — how will I get home…

lines.speaker: A
lines.ja: よろしければ、一階の受付で傘をお貸ししております。次にご来店の際に返していただければ結構です。
lines.en: If you like, we lend umbrellas at the first-floor reception. You can return it on your next visit.

lines.speaker: B
lines.ja: それは助かります。じゃあ、これを書いたら一階に行きます。
lines.en: That's a big help. Then I'll go down to the first floor after filling this in.

questions.question: What does Ono decide to do about his own umbrella?
choices: Take the folding umbrella that was handed in
Go back upstairs and search the restroom
Leave his details so the store can contact him
Wait at the desk until it is found

Borrow an umbrella downstairs
Meet his friend inside the store
Wait at the desk for a call
